name: Andrew Ramirez
office: Keppel Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Andrew Ramirez is a member of the Keppel Union School District Governing Board. He was elected in November 2022. In December 2023, he voted to terminate the superintendent’s contract without cause at a special meeting. This vote prompted a recall effort, but the petitions were not approved for circulation.
